reason: LeanToken is an MCP-based code search and retrieval layer that helps agents locate relevant repository evidence within explicit token budgets; the README describes local indexing and read-only discovery rather than code editing or execution.

summaries.zh: LeanToken 是一个面向智能体的 MCP 代码搜索与检索工具，可通过本地索引、结构分析和受限读取帮助定位相关代码并控制上下文令牌使用量。
summaries.en: LeanToken is an agent-focused MCP code search and retrieval tool that uses local indexing, structural analysis, and bounded reads to locate relevant code while managing context token usage.

capabilities: Searches and retrieves relevant files, symbols, ranges, history, and bounded JSON data
Provides MCP tools for agent-oriented codebase discovery
Installs or updates selected client configuration during setup
